correctness.rationale: For exactly three particles on the unit-rate 3-site complete graph with uniformly chosen surviving donor and |ε|<1, derive the ten-state count generator L(c,c−e_a+e_b)=c_a+(c_a c_b k_a)/2 and the 18-state founder operator including two offspring when founder is copied. Normalization at k=(1,1,1) makes the stationary and founder systems analytic near ε=0. Coefficient-wise rational linear solves yield d_1=d_3=0, d_5=89/56010528; reflection of sites 0↔2 gives exact oddness and O(ε^7). Independently rebuilt both rational systems and Taylor recursion in private check_quintic.py; result [0,0,0,0,0,89/56010528] exactly. This proves strict positive current for sufficiently small positive ε, not global sign. Source verifier and cited nonperturbative test independently inspected, but a checker alone is not proof.
